subject: Show changes
body:
Hi Ben,

I have removed the event from the website for you. As it's un-ticketed we can't contact anyone planning to attend to let them know of the cancellation, but it will no longer be online.

Many thanks,

Elin Eaton (she/her)
Box Office Manager
A: Office 4 at The Old Court House, 118 Church Street, Brighton, BN1 1UD
P: 01273 91 72 72
W: www.brightonfringe.org
notes: Confirms un-ticketed show was removed from site but no attendees can be notified due to lack of booking records.
